camel_example: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/workspaces/12340000002/config --region cn-hangzhou --ConfigKey tempStoragePath --Verbose 'oss://000' --CategoryName CommonResourceConfig --header "Content-Type=application/json"
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace get-config --workspace-id 12340000002 --category-name CommonResourceConfig --config-key tempStoragePath --verbose oss://000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetConfig

parameters.help_en:
The category of the configuration item. The following categories are supported:

CommonResourceConfig: common resource configuration
DLCAutoRecycle: DLC automatic reclamation
DLCPriorityConfig: DLC priority settings
DSWPriorityConfig: DSW priority settings
QuotaMaximumDuration: maximum runtime duration configuration for DLC jobs in a quota
CommonTagConfig: tag settings
parameters.help_zh:
配置项的分类。目前支持如下分类

CommonResourceConfig 通用资源配置
DLCAutoRecycle  DLC自动回收
DLCPriorityConfig DLC 优先级设置
DSWPriorityConfig DSW优先级设置
QuotaMaximumDuration Quota的DLC任务最大运行时长配置
CommonTagConfig 标签设置
parameters.name: category_name

parameters.help_en:
The key of the configuration item. The following keys are supported:

tempStoragePath: the temporary storage path. This key is valid only when CategoryName is set to CommonResourceConfig.
isAutoRecycle: the automatic reclamation configuration. This key is valid only when CategoryName is set to DLCAutoRecycle.
priorityConfig: the priority configuration. This key is valid only when CategoryName is set to DLCPriorityConfig or DSWPriorityConfig.
quotaMaximumDuration: the maximum runtime duration configuration for DLC jobs in a quota. This key is valid only when CategoryName is set to QuotaMaximumDuration.
predefinedTags: the preset tags for the workspace. Resources created in the workspace must include these tags
parameters.help_zh:
配置项的键。目前支持如下键：

tempStoragePath 临时存储路径，只有CategoryName为CommonResourceConfig时才允许使用该ConfigKey
isAutoRecycle 自动回收配置，只有CategoryName为DLCAutoRecycle时才允许使用该ConfigKey
priorityConfig  优先级配置，只有CategoryName为DLCPriorityConfig或者DSWPriorityConfig时才允许使用该ConfigKey
quotaMaximumDuration Quota的DLC任务最大运行时长配置，只有CategoryName为QuotaMaximumDuration时才允许使用该ConfigKey
predefinedTags 工作空间预置标签，创建的资源必须带上标签
parameters.name: config_key

parameters.help_en: The value of the configuration item
parameters.name: verbose
